facts.fact: UNFPA Djibouti says the Ministry of Health, with UNFPA support, is integrating gender-based violence case data into the National Health Information System (DHIS2), whose operational administration is run by the Health Information Directorate.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Health Information Directorate

facts.fact: WHO Djibouti's management response of 14 April 2025 says DHIS2 is implemented at primary health care level, with challenges in its use, and that the DHIS2 system is to be reviewed and enhanced and resources sought to revamp the data system and ensure data connectivity at national level.

note: The body names no health information system; the DHIS2 figures appear only in the file's note, not in the document text.
Djibouti entry lists only a health development plan and no standalone digital instrument; it names no health information system.
The document names no national routine reporting system in service; only a tracker built on DHIS2.
A medicines stock system with no link to routine health reporting stated, so other.
